bandReport.notes: Contiguous 75-90, no gaps. Seams clean in both directions: p11 (band before) ends with Q74 complete at the foot of its right column, and p12 opens a fresh Q75; p14 ends with Q90 complete and p15 (band after) opens a fresh Q91. NO Directions / 'for the next N items' block appears anywhere on p11-p15, so no set straddles either seam and no question in this range carries shared stimulus. NO printed diagram appears on p12, p13 or p14 — verified at 5-7x on the source PDF for every geometry and mensuration item in the range (Q81 incircle touching AB/AC, Q85 median AD with P on it, Q87 right triangle with P on AC and Q on BC, Q88 four coins at the vertices of a square, Q89 bucket frustum); each of these is stated entirely in words, so hasFigure is false throughout. Every page in this band is a clean two-column layout with four options printed under each stem; nothing was unreadable.
